title: Weekend and After-Hours Multipliers for Onsite Service Visits — TimeBank
content:
Service band schedule of TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours: the block hours of a service visit resolved on a Saturday or Sunday are multiplied by the block's holiday multiplier; those of a weekday service visit resolved in the onsite after-hours class, by the block's after-hours multiplier; those of a weekday business-hours service visit, by 1. The day and the class are those of the ticket's resolution in the ClearPath ticket history; a weekday observed holiday takes the multiplier of the resolution's class.

| Resolution | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| Saturday or Sunday | holiday multiplier of the block's size |
| Monday to Friday, onsite after-hours class | after-hours multiplier of the block's size |
| Monday to Friday, onsite business-hours class | 1 |

Hypothetical case on a TimeBank 80-Hour Block (holiday multiplier 2.0, after-hours multiplier 1.5) for a visit converting to 2.00 hours before this multiplier: 4.00 hours if resolved on a Sunday, 3.00 hours on a weekday in the after-hours class, 2.00 hours on a weekday in the business-hours class, including a weekday observed holiday resolved in the business-hours class.
